item.title: What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Why It Became AI's Most Important Protocol in 2026
item.description: Every AI product I use daily — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor — quietly picked up support for the same protocol this year, and I kept running into it before I actually understood what it was. I’d see “MCP server” mentioned in a plugin’s README, or a coworker would say “just wire it up over MCP,” and I’d nod along without a clear mental model of what was actually happening under the hood.
